description: Check up to 25 products against eBay before any write, with the same live preflight the CRM's eBay channel page and the real draft and publish calls run. Per product it returns the eBay state (off, member, draft, live, ended), nextAction (create_draft, publish_draft or none), whether that step is ready and, when not, the blocking reason with details. ebayDraftSetup lists the armed eBay sites and their currencies; remediation.ebayPlaybook maps every reason to the tool that fixes it; publishingEnabled says whether the owner allows AI to publish in this workspace. Reads eBay, never writes. Use search_products first for the ids; after a fix with update_product, upsert_product_prices, upsert_product_attributes or upsert_product_translation, call it again — a reason can change or clear.

marketplaceId.description: Omit it when the eBay connection sells on one site — the server fills it in. Pass one of ebayDraftSetup.marketplaceIds only when several are armed. A MARKETPLACE id such as EBAY_IT, never the eBay connection id.

productIds.description: The products to check, at most 25 ids from search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
